title: uwuifierv2
description: A lightweight mod that changes all your messages to uwuified messages! /uwu to toggle
body:
## Turn your _ordinary_ Minecraft chat into **an adorable, kawaii paradise!** 
The UWUify Chat mod automatically transforms your messages with playful “uwu-speak,” cute emoticons, and quirky substitutions that give your chat a whimsical personality. Perfect for roleplay servers, lighthearted builds, or just spreading smiles in multiplayer. You can toggle it on and off using /uwu
